metrics.name: overall_accuracy
metrics.description: Proportion of correct judgments across all 60 trials. Singh et al. (2019) report 0.65-0.78 across base-rate conditions for adult MTurk participants.

metrics.name: pre_training_accuracy
metrics.description: Accuracy on the 10 pre-training trials (no feedback yet). Singh et al. report ~0.62 for adult humans.

metrics.name: post_training_accuracy
metrics.description: Accuracy on the 10 post-training trials (after 40 training trials with feedback). Singh et al. report ~0.78 for adult humans.

metrics.name: hit_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of phishing emails correctly classified as phishing. Singh et al. report 0.74-0.85 for adult humans.

metrics.name: false_alarm_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of legitimate emails incorrectly flagged as phishing. Singh et al. report 0.20-0.30 for adult humans.
